title: World of Empires III is out on Google Play Store and App Store
author: visualbruno
selftext:
Hi everyone

I would like to share with the community the game I developed with the help of AI.

I used my free tool, [https://www.3dgenstudio.com](https://www.3dgenstudio.com), to generate the 3D models, and Claude helped me refine the world-building as well as the AI-controlled players.

It is a turn-based 4X strategy game, in the style of Civilization, currently available on mobile.

Please feel free to share your feedback.

Thank you!

Google Play Store: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.newsoftvision.woe3](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.newsoftvision.woe3)

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/world-of-empires-iii/id6833500263](https://apps.apple.com/app/world-of-empires-iii/id6833500263)

More info at [https://www.newsoftvision.com](https://www.newsoftvision.com)

YouTube Announcement Trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UE2QVv9xjI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UE2QVv9xjI)
